operations.details: Verified official OGC API - Processes standard page.
Process execution separated from source accuracy and provenance.
Derived process output not promoted above input quality without independent evidence.
Algorithm availability not treated as validation of terrain or boundary semantics.
Verified official OGC Environmental Data Retrieval standard page.
EDR query pattern separated from underlying environmental resource quality.
Response inherits source datum, survey date and measurement uncertainty.
Environmental query geometry not substituted for exact HMLR parcel identity.
Processes and EDR standard URLs distinct from prior source registry.
No process output or generic EDR response substituted for official parcel result.
Canonical manifest untouched; serial publisher required.
